description: Field contract, not a filled worker result. All required fields must be populated with actual evidence. Paths are repository-relative.

required_fields.worker: Actual model/agent and execution ID; never infer from task destination
required_fields.exact_claim: Quantified statement including scope and assumptions
required_fields.new_assumptions: Array; empty only if none were added
required_fields.input_sha256: Mapping of repository-relative paths to actual hashes
required_fields.artifacts_sha256: Mapping of output paths to hashes, excluding this self-referential result file
required_fields.commands: Actual executed argv lists, or empty with reason for proof-only task
required_fields.execution_bounds: Requested and actually enforced wall/CPU/thread/log limits
required_fields.checks: Array of named controls with observed result, tolerance and pass/fail
required_fields.tested_domain: Actual numeric box, samples, units, seed and exclusions; or exact proof domain
required_fields.failed_attempts: Paths and causes; empty if none
required_fields.limitations: What the result does not establish
required_fields.suggested_followup: One discriminating next task or an explained route stop

proof_only_exception: Proof-only work may omit computational manifests but must provide raw derivation, source hashes and a separate review. Do not fabricate commands or numeric tests.
